text:
deploybot: rollout observed routing mismatch during change window in us-west-2, recommending automated revert to previous image v2.4.0. urgent flag raised. :rotating_light:

sam: noticed spike in embedding cost and small increase in error-rate for low-volume tenants. not widespread but visible.

elena: what triggered deploybot? threshold was set to cost_ratio>2.0 for 3m; we hit 2.3 for 4m.

ops-raj: auto-revert kicks in 5m from now. do we want to override? change window still open for another 40m.

pm-talia: from product POV, prefer targeted manual action first (move routing for affected tenants) to avoid global revert during churn. can we patch routing table?

ops-raj: we can shift traffic for tenant groups A+B to fallback route with older runtime. command:
```bash
rdwctl traffic shift --region us-west-2 --tenants "A,B" --to fallback-v2.4.0 --percent 100
```

comms-bot: draft customer note available at https://internal.redwood/notes/drafts/6187654321.legal checks required for billing messages.

sre-lin: monitoring on. watchlist: embedding_errors, embed_cost_p90, tenant_error_rate. will report in 6m.

(6m later)

ops-raj: traffic shift applied for A+B. metrics: tenant_error_rate down to baseline, embed_cost reduced 55% for those tenants. global cost still elevated ~1.3x due to B2B test traffic.

sam: good, targeted fix avoided global churn. can we disable auto-revert for 30m to let system stabilize?

deploybot: auto-revert suppression requested by @sam. suppression_expiry=30m. reason=targeted_mitigation_in_progress

pm-talia: please prepare release notes update: include note "hotfix: targeted traffic shift to fallback runtime for tenants A and B to mitigate embedding cost spike."

elena: engineering prefers leaving version unpinned for now but will add a temporary safety pin if we see regressions reoccur.

ops-raj: timeline: continue monitoring for 2h. if affected_tenants > 5 and global_cost > 1.5x, escalate with tag rollback_exec and proceed to full revert. otherwise, roll forward once stable and remove suppression.

sre-lin: setting alert: if embed_cost_p90 > 1.5x baseline for 10m -> notify eng-releases with priority=high.

comms-bot: legal looped in. Customer comms draft ready for A+B. will send once PM approves final wording.

sam: adding short postmortem TODO to runbook: verify kernel-flag and routing mapping in canary for multi-tenant test traffic.

pm-talia: approved customer note. thanks team.

deploybot: suppression expired after 30m, auto-revert re-enabled. thread closed; reopen if alerts fire.
